title: Hey #lieracies folks as you post next "look at me and how I fight for #SocialJustice" pic on facebook and instagram know NAACP is calling for a nation
summary: Hey #lieracies folks as you post next "look at me and how I fight for #SocialJustice" pic on facebook and instagram know NAACP is calling for a national boycott. You are fighting for rights on a platform used to reinforce systemic racism and voter suppression.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Hey #lieracies folks as you post next "look at me and how I fight for #SocialJustice" pic on facebook and instagram know NAACP is calling for a national boycott. You are fighting for rights on a platform used to reinforce systemic racism and voter suppression.
